shots.name: <场景名>·九机位
shots.prompt:
Additions that must hold in EVERY panel: the floor is <具体材质>, never stone or tile; the ceiling is <具体材质>, never pale plaster; the <关键家具> is <颜色材质>; and a <副光> shadow sits in <位置>, contrasting the <主光>. Keep exactly these materials and this palette in all nine panels.

Create one single image that is a contact sheet: exactly 3 columns by 3 rows, nine equal landscape panels separated by slim pale grey gutters, thin and even. Every panel shows THE SAME <空间名> - the same <材质1>, the same <材质2>, the same <光源>. Lighting and palette are identical in all nine panels; only the camera position changes.

Panel 1: <入口全景，正对主区>
Panel 2: <高机位俯视主区>
Panel 3: <过道纵深，同向消失点>
Panel 4: <次要出口，暖光外溢>
Panel 5: <低机位仰视顶面与灯>
Panel 6: <角落家具与台灯，软焦背景>
Panel 7: <物件微距>
Panel 8: <贴地机位，地面材质>
Panel 9: <反打，从主区回望入口>

Rule for all panels: absolutely no people, no figures, no hands, no faces. Empty room in every panel. No text, no labels, no numbers, no panel captions, no watermark. Nothing is cropped out of a panel and no panel repeats another.
